summary_1line: Bhishma devastates the Pandava forces until Krishna urges a reluctant Arjuna to confront his grandsire and fulfill his warrior’s duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands blazing on his chariot like a forest fire, arrows streaming in all directions as shattered chariots and elephants fall around him.
The battlefield lies strewn with broken chariots, severed standards, and fallen warriors while riderless horses drag empty cars across the field.
Krishna halts the silver-horsed chariot and speaks urgently as Arjuna, head bowed in conflict, prepares to face the radiant Bhishma in battle.
